pcs.pc_description: maintain the cleanliness of the work area using approved sanitizers and keep it free from dust, pests, and flies.
Clean the testing equipment with an approved cleaning agent following SOP guidelines.
verify the working and performance of all sampling devices and other equipment used in the lab as per the standard operating procedure
maintain glassware by cleaning, washing, sterilizing, and distributing.
monitor the temperatures of freezers and refrigerators.
clean N-Evap, water bath, refrigerators, and foreheads.
adhere to procedures for sample return, disposal, and archiving.
keep laboratory supplies ready by inventorying stock, placing orders, and verifying receipts
adhere to safety guidelines at all times within the laboratory.

maintain all quality parameters as per QC norms

modules.module_title: Sample for quality analysis (for food lab activities)

pcs.pc_description: read and understand the sampling instructions from the food lab technician

• categorize various types of materials as per the standard operating procedure(SOP) • types: perishable, semi-perishable, non-perishable, or raw or processed foods of agricultural products, foods of animal origin, dairy foods, Ready to eat foods and miscellaneous products (samples from outlets)
analyse the sample materials to ensure compliance with quality standards and specifications
document sampling activities and analysis results for traceability and quality control purposes.
collect the pre-shipment samples sent by the vendors from the purchase/supply chain department
collect samples from effluent treatment plant following procedures and standards of the organisation
collect samples received from the market such as customer/consumer complaint samples, market samples, competitor sample
label the samples with details like sample name, date and time of sampling, batch/manufacture /expiry details (as applicable)
collect all documents pertaining to incoming lab samples like copy of purchase order, invoice, certificate of analysis etc for verification and records
ensure all documents are provided by the supplier as per organisation standards
transfer the samples to food lab and place in the designated area for analysis
record the sample details in the lab register and file the supplier documents
file and maintain all documents related to sample along with the test report
transfer the production control sample and shelf life sample to the control sample/shelf-life sample room
• monitor and maintain the storage conditions (like temperature, humidity, cleanliness etc) of the • control sample/ shelf-life sample room

• dispose the control sample and shelf-life sample after the control period following disposal procedures and as per organisation standards • procedure: step1 Segregate wastes based on properties and compatibility to prevent reactions or • contamination like chemical, biological, and radioactive wastes • step 2. label the waste containers properly with type and hazards, and store them in designated areas. • type: chemical, biological, solid waste, general waste
treat and neutralize wastes before disposal as per the waste disposal standards
maintain the documentation for waste disposal process
document market samples for quality standards and regulatory compliance.
